title: A closer casino floor
summary: The casino's rectangular hall brings the surrounding promenade and shops closer to the gaming pit.
notes: Reduce the main casino hall to 48 by 40 metres while preserving the 30 by 24 metre gaming pit and its ramps.
Move the food court and pawn shop closer to the south entrance and update their GPS markers.
Extend chandelier light reach and include GridMap tiles in room visibility bounds so distant walls stay visible.
